protocol.title: Processing Stimulus Dynamics by the NF-kB Network in Single Cells
protocol.objective: Characterise NF-kB signaling responses to pulsatile stimulation, increasing/fluctuating stimulus doses, and sequential multi-ligand combinations at single-cell resolution using live-cell fluorescence imaging in microfluidic devices

device.throughput: Up to 64 experimental conditions simultaneously (Son et al. Sci. Signal. 2021)
device.channel_configuration: Individual isolated cell culture chambers with addressable perfusion inlets
device.imaging: Time-lapse fluorescence microscopy; frame interval 3-5 min over 8-10 h stimulation windows
device.reporter_system: p65-RFP or p65-GFP nuclear translocation; N:C ratio measured per cell per frame
device.flow_control: Programmable syringe pumps or pressure controllers; valve-gated stimulus delivery
references: Gómez-Sjöberg et al. Anal. Chem. 2007 (ref 74) - versatile automated microfluidic cell culture system
Kellogg & Tay Cell 2015 (ref 17) - noise facilitates transcriptional control under dynamic inputs
Son et al. Sci. Signal. 2021 (ref 13) - 64-condition high-throughput microfluidic platform

cell_media.MEF: DMEM + 10% FBS, no antibiotics, 37 C, 5% CO2
cell_media.H1299: RPMI-1640 + 10% FBS, no antibiotics, 37 C, 5% CO2
cell_media.HeLa: DMEM + 10% FBS, no antibiotics, 37 C, 5% CO2

TNFalpha.supplier_note: Human recombinant TNF-a; homotrimer; signals via TNFR-TRADD-RIP1-TRAF2/5-TAK1-IKK

LPS.signals_via: TLR4 -> MyD88/IRAK1/TRAF6 AND TRIF-TRAM (after TLR4 endocytosis) -> IKK
LPS.nfkb_response: Singular activation without clear oscillation in fibroblasts and epithelial cells (vs. oscillatory in macrophages)

PAM2CSK4.description: Synthetic analog of bacterial lipopeptide; TLR1/2 agonist
PAM2CSK4.special_property: Does NOT exhibit differentiator-like NF-kB response to changing concentration (unlike TNF-a and IL-1b)

nfkb_pathway.dominant_dimer: p65/p50 heterodimer (most abundant in almost all cell types)

negative_feedback_proteins.IkBa: Primary fast negative feedback; newly translated IkBa exports NF-kB from nucleus
negative_feedback_proteins.A20: Upstream of IKK; edits ubiquitin scaffolds on TRAF complexes; induced by nuclear NF-kB; establishes refractory state (~60 min post-stimulation)
negative_feedback_proteins.CYLD: Deubiquitinates IKK scaffolds; upstream of IKK; induced by nuclear NF-kB
negative_feedback_proteins.IRAK-M: TLR/IL-1R specific; induced by nuclear NF-kB
negative_feedback_proteins.MyD88S: TLR/IL-1R specific splice variant; inhibits downstream signaling
negative_feedback_proteins.IkBd: Noncanonical; p100 homodimer; mediates broad cross-tolerance on 24 h timescale

ikk_complex.note: IKK cycling between active and inactive states is necessary for NF-kB signal transduction (Behar & Hoffmann Biophys. J. 2013)

oscillation.mechanism: IKK activation -> IkBa degradation -> NF-kB nuclear translocation -> IkBa re-synthesis -> NF-kB nuclear export -> cycle repeats if IKK remains active
oscillation.damping: Oscillations damp under continuous stimulation due to A20/CYLD upstream inhibition

steps.name: Device priming
steps.notes: 2% Pluronics F-127 in PBS; perfused through channels to prevent non-specific cell adhesion to PDMS walls. Standard pre-treatment for microfluidic cell culture (Samlali et al. Small 2020; Son et al. Biosens. Bioelectron. 2023)

steps.name: Single-cell loading and equilibration
steps.operation: flow-through loading into individual chambers (abstracted as mix in BioScript)
steps.notes: Cells loaded at low density to achieve single-cell occupancy per chamber. Equilibration ensures baseline NF-kB is cytoplasmic (N:C ratio ~1) before stimulation. Reporter: p65-RFP enables real-time nuclear translocation tracking (Nelson et al. J. Cell Sci. 2002; Tay et al. Nature 2010)

steps.name: Pulsatile TNF-a stimulation - Pulse 1
steps.notes: 15 min TNF-a pulse delivered via programmable valve. At 200 min inter-pulse period (low frequency), NF-kB system fully resets between pulses; full-amplitude response maintained across all pulses (Ashall et al. Science 2009). At high frequency (<100 min period), response amplitude diminishes after each pulse.

steps.name: Pulsatile TNF-a stimulation - Pulse 2
steps.notes: Second 15 min TNF-a pulse after 185 min recovery. A20 and IkBa fully degraded/reset; IKK back to neutral state. Kellogg & Tay (Cell 2015) showed noise in NF-kB oscillation facilitates entrainment and downstream gene expression across a range of feeding frequencies.

steps.name: Pulsatile TNF-a stimulation - Pulse 3
steps.notes: Third 15 min TNF-a pulse. Confirms sustained full-amplitude NF-kB responses at low-frequency pulsatile regime. Contrasts with high-frequency (60 min period) regime where NF-kB amplitude diminishes progressively (Ashall et al. Science 2009 - ref 72 in paper).

steps.name: NF-kB translocation detection - pulsatile arm
steps.readout: p65-RFP nuclear-to-cytoplasmic (N:C) ratio per cell per frame
steps.notes: NF-kB translocation confirmed by N:C ratio > 1 at peak. Oscillation period ~90 min under continuous TNF-a; single peak under brief pulse; full amplitude maintained at 200 min inter-pulse interval.

steps.name: Fresh cell loading for sequential arm
steps.operation: device re-prime, fresh cell loading, equilibration
steps.notes: Independent cell chamber population for sequential multi-ligand experiment. Same priming and equilibration as Steps S1-S2. Fresh p65-RFP MEF reporter cells.

steps.name: Sequential stimulation - Ligand 1: TNF-a (0-120 min)
steps.signals_via: TNFR -> TRADD/RIP1/TRAF2/5 -> TAK1 -> IKK (does NOT use IRAK1/MyD88)
steps.notes: Primary NF-kB response: 1-3 damped oscillation peaks. A20 upregulation partially suppresses subsequent TRAF2/5-dependent signaling. TNF-a-specific negative feedback does NOT cross-tolerize IL-1b or LPS arms (different receptor complexes). Wang et al. Cell Rep. 2022 (ref 15).

steps.name: Sequential stimulation - Ligand 2: IL-1b (120-240 min)
steps.notes: Despite elevated A20 from prior TNF-a, IL-1b can reactivate NF-kB without attenuation (different receptor complex). IRAK1 begins to autophosphorylate, encoding IL-1b memory. At high dose, IRAK1 aggregation creates cross-tolerogenic state for subsequent IL-1b and LPS but not TNF-a (DeFelice et al. Sci. Signal. 2019 - ref 64). Adamson et al. Nat. Commun. 2016 (ref 73).

steps.name: Sequential stimulation - Ligand 3: LPS (240-360 min)
steps.signals_via: TLR4 -> MyD88/IRAK1/TRAF6 (myddosome) AND TRIF-TRAM (after TLR4 endocytosis)
steps.cross_tolerance_mechanism: IRAK1 autophosphorylation and aggregation from prior IL-1b exposure reduces signaling through shared myddosome complex
steps.notes: LPS and IL-1b share the IRAK1/MyD88 myddosome. If IRAK1 is aggregated from S9, cells enter cross-tolerogenic state: LPS-driven NF-kB response is attenuated. 100 ng/mL LPS drives further IRAK1 clustering, deepening cross-tolerance state for S10. NF-kB response: singular activation without oscillation in fibroblasts. DeFelice et al. Sci. Signal. 2019 (ref 64).

steps.name: Sequential stimulation - Ligand 4: PAM2CSK4 (360-480 min)
steps.notes: PAM2CSK4 shares the myddosome with IL-1b and LPS. After IRAK1 clustering from S9+S10, PAM response is significantly attenuated. Unlike TNF-a and IL-1b, PAM does NOT exhibit differentiator-like NF-kB behaviour (response does not track concentration changes; Son et al. Sci. Signal. 2021 - ref 13). Full 8 h sequence: TNF-a(2h)->IL-1b(2h)->LPS(2h)->PAM(2h) produces distinct NF-kB oscillation patterns per Wang et al. Cell Rep. 2022 (ref 15).

steps.name: NF-kB translocation detection - sequential arm
steps.readout: Composite NF-kB dynamics across all 4 ligands: oscillation period, amplitude, damping, inter-peak intervals
steps.notes: Distinct NF-kB oscillation patterns encode stimulus sequence and identity via IRAK1 and IkBd memory. Wang et al. Cell Rep. 2022 demonstrated 4-ligand sequence encodes unique NF-kB response patterns per ligand-order combination.

steps.name: Downstream gene expression readout
steps.key_finding: NF-kB translocation dynamics (amplitude, duration, oscillation period) correlated with proinflammatory gene expression profiles at single-cell level. Subpopulation of proinflammatory genes not upregulated in cells with shorter initial NF-kB oscillation duration.
references: Lane et al. Cells 2017 (ref 120) - NF-kB signaling dynamics correlated with target gene expression in single cells
Sen et al. Cell Syst. 2020 (ref 16) - duration decoding through chromatin remodeling
Cheng et al. Science 2021 (ref 14) - NF-kB dynamics determine epigenomic reprogramming in macrophages

steps.name: Cell viability QC (pass branch only)
steps.notes: FDA (live, green; ex 490 nm, em 526 nm) and PI (dead, red; ex 488 nm, em 617 nm) staining. Confirms stimulation protocol does not induce significant apoptosis across 8 h multi-ligand sequence. Consistent with methodology from Samlali et al. Small 2020.

low_frequency.effect: Full NF-kB system reset between pulses; sustained full-amplitude responses; A20 and IkBa fully degraded before next pulse

high_frequency.effect: Diminishing NF-kB response amplitude after each pulse; insufficient time for IKK reset and A20 degradation

resonance.effect: Single-cell NF-kB oscillations synchronised; maximum amplitude in subsequent peaks; noise facilitates entrainment across range of frequencies

refractory_period.mechanism: A20-dependent; established upstream of IKK activation; cells do not respond to restimulation with the same ligand during this window

differentiator_behavior.description: NF-kB response tracks the CHANGE in cytokine level (delta), not the absolute dose. Analogous to a differentiator in electronic circuits.
differentiator_behavior.mechanism: A20-mediated upstream IKK inhibition sets a dynamic threshold; cytokine increase overcomes A20 inhibition and resets IKK cycling
differentiator_behavior.reference: Son et al. Sci. Signal. 2021 (ref 13); Cruz et al. Sci. Adv. 2021 (ref 85)

non_differentiator.description: PAM NF-kB response does not track concentration changes; responds to absolute dose levels

cross_tolerance_mechanisms.mechanism: Autophosphorylation and aggregation; inhibits myddosome downstream signaling for both IL-1b and LPS but NOT TNF-a

cross_tolerance_mechanisms.trigger: 24 h prior exposure to LPS, TNF-a, or IL-1b
cross_tolerance_mechanisms.mechanism: Noncanonical NF-kB inhibitor; broad cross-tolerance between multiple stimuli

sequential_stimulation.memory_encoding: Distinct NF-kB oscillation patterns per 4-ligand sequence; feedback remodeling is dose- and ligand-specific

cell_type_specificity.fibroblasts: Oscillatory NF-kB under continuous TNF-a; singular activation under LPS; limited polyI:C response
cell_type_specificity.macrophages: Oscillatory NF-kB under TNF-a AND LPS; polyI:C oscillatory; epigenetic reprogramming by NF-kB dynamics
cell_type_specificity.epithelial: Oscillatory NF-kB under TNF-a; limited LPS and polyI:C response
cell_type_specificity.reference: Adelaja et al. Immunity 2021 (ref 11); Cheng et al. Science 2021 (ref 14)

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.content: Device priming, cell loading, equilibration, pulsatile TNF-a arm (3 pulses at 200 min period), NF-kB translocation detection

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_4_j
basic_blocks.content: dispose(nfkbSignal); fresh cell loading; sequential 4-ligand stimulation arm (TNF-a->IL-1b->LPS->PAM, 2h each); sequential NF-kB detection

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_8_t
basic_blocks.action: FDA/PI viability stain, detect, dispose all

bioscript_compiler_notes.ir_output: 10 basic blocks (BB1-BB10), 3 if/else gates, 12 CFG edges
bioscript_compiler_notes.duration_units: All durations in seconds (s) or minutes (m); hours not supported
bioscript_compiler_notes.unicode_fix: All Greek characters (kappa, alpha, beta, delta) and arrow symbols replaced with ASCII equivalents; required for ANTLR4 FileStream ASCII codec
bioscript_compiler_notes.mix_abstraction: mix operations model microfluidic valve-gated perfusion of stimulus into cell chamber; not DMF electrode mixing
bioscript_compiler_notes.heat_abstraction: heat steps model inter-pulse incubation/wash recovery periods at physiological temperature (37 C)
bioscript_compiler_notes.arms_note: Two independent experimental arms encoded in sequence: (1) pulsatile TNF-a arm (BB1->BB4) and (2) sequential 4-ligand arm (BB4->BB7). Fresh cell populations used for each arm.
